entry.title: OECD data show graduate unemployment rising for the first time since its records began
entry.summary:
Rahoton OECD na Education at a Glance 2026, wanda aka ƙaddamar a ranar 29 ga Satumba 2026, ya gano cewa rashin aikin yi tsakanin matasa masu shekaru 25 zuwa 34 da ke da digiri na jami'a ya ƙaru da kashi 0.4 cikin ɗari a ƙasashe membobi tsakanin 2023 da 2025, yayin da rashin aikin yi tsakanin waɗanda ke da ilimin sakandare kawai ya ragu da kashi 0.2 cikin ɗari, abin da ya taƙaita gibin da aka saba gani, kuma shi ne karo na farko da hakan ya faru tun da aka fara tattara waɗannan alƙaluma a shekarar 2000. Koriya ta Kudu ta nuna wannan yanayi a fili: kashi 71.1 cikin ɗari na matasanta masu shekaru 25 zuwa 34 suna da takardar shaidar manyan makarantu, fiye da matsakaicin OECD na kashi 47.5 cikin ɗari, amma yawan aikin yi ga waɗanda suka kammala karatu a ƙasar na kashi 80.1 cikin ɗari ya gaza matsakaicin OECD na kashi 86 cikin ɗari.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 4, ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, wannan ita ce alama mafi bayyana zuwa yanzu a faɗin ƙasashen OECD cewa amfanin digiri a kasuwar ƙwadago yana raguwa a daidai lokacin da AI ke sauya ayyukan matakin farko, yanayin da ya kamata Wits AHEAD ta bibiya tare da bayanan Afirka ta Kudu kan inda waɗanda suka kammala karatu ke zuwa.

OECD, Education at a Glance 2026 (via UPI) · Intergovernmental body data, reported by an international wire service

entry.title: Côte d'Ivoire launches UNESCO-backed AI training for 3,000 vocational education teachers
entry.summary:
Ƙaramin Ministan Ilimin Fasaha da Koyar da Sana'o'i na Côte d'Ivoire, Jean-Louis Moulot, ya ƙaddamar a ranar 25 ga Satumba 2026 da shirin horar da malaman koyar da sana'o'i, masu sa ido kan koyarwa da jami'an gudanarwa 3,000 a fannin ƙirƙirarriyar basira (AI), tare da tallafin fasaha daga UNESCO. Kashi na farko zai gudana daga 1 ga Oktoba zuwa 30 ga Disamba 2026, inda za a horar da malamai 1,000 a Abidjan kan tushen AI, amfaninsa a ilimi, hanyoyin tantancewa, ɗa'a da tsaron bayanai, kafin a tantance gwajin don faɗaɗa shi a faɗin ƙasar.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 3, AI da nazarin bayanai a STEM da horar da malamai, wannan shiri ne da ba kasafai ake samu ba wanda gwamnati ke jagoranta tare da goyon bayan UNESCO, kuma yana horar da masu horar da malamai da kansu ba ɗalibansu kaɗai ba, samfurin da Wits AHEAD za ta iya amfani da shi a aikinta tare da kwalejojin fasaha da koyar da sana'o'i na Afirka ta Kudu.

TrendsnAfrica · Government programme launch with UNESCO technical support, reported by regional press

entry.title: Ghana commits to train 100,000 TVET facilitators in AI under new UNESCO and Microsoft partnership
entry.summary:
Hukumar Ilimin Fasaha da Koyar da Sana'o'i (TVET) ta Ghana ta sanya hannu kan yarjejeniyar fahimtar juna tare da UNESCO, KPMG da Microsoft a ranar 30 ga Satumba 2026 don horar da aƙalla masu koyarwa 100,000 na TVET a fannin ƙirƙirarriyar basira da ƙwarewar dijital ƙarƙashin shirin AI EmpowerED. Babban daraktan Hukumar TVET, Dr Eric Kofi Adzroe, ya ce haɗin gwiwar na nuna sauyi zuwa tsarin da ya dace da masana'antu, wanda fasaha ke tafiyarwa kuma yake mai da hankali kan sakamako, yayin da wakilin UNESCO a ƙasar, Edmond Moukala, ya sanya hannu kan yarjejeniyar a madadin ƙungiyar.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 4, ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, ba wa masu koyar da fasaha da sana'o'i ƙwarewar AI a wannan mataki zai iya sauya yadda dukkan wani ƙarni na masu sana'a da ƙwararrun fasaha na Afirka ke shiga kasuwar ƙwadagon da AI ke sauyawa, samfurin da Wits AHEAD ke bibiya don ɗaukar darussan da suka dace da ɓangaren TVET na Afirka ta Kudu.

Graphic Online · National press, government partnership announcement

entry.title: US learning platform data shows AI tools trail far behind other classroom technology
entry.summary:
Sabon rahoton Instructure na EdTech Top 40, wanda aka gina kan bayanan da aka ɓoye sunaye na masu amfani miliyan 19.5 a manyan makarantu na dandalin koyo na Canvas tsakanin Satumba 2025 da Afrilu 2026, ya gano cewa Google Gemini, kayan aikin AI na musamman da aka fi amfani da shi, ya kai ga masu amfani 87,788 kacal a cibiyoyi 211, kuma bai shiga cikin kayan aiki 100 da aka fi haɗawa ba. Tsofaffin kayan aiki kamar McGraw Hill, mai masu amfani miliyan 11.3, tantance kwasa-kwasai na Watermark da Zoom sun ci gaba da kasancewa mafi amfani nesa ba kusa ba. Mataimakin shugaban Instructure, Ryan Lufkin, ya ce jami'o'i suna sanya hannu kan yarjejeniyoyin AI na dukkan cibiya ba tare da sun riga sun shigar da kayan aikin cikin aikin kwas na yau da kullum ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, gibin da ke tsakanin lasisin AI na cibiyoyi da ainihin amfani a aji gargaɗi ne da Wits AHEAD ke bibiya: sayen damar amfani da kayan aikin AI ba ɗaya yake da shigar da su cikin koyarwa da tantancewa ba, kuma aikin ƙungiyar kan amfani a aikace yana magana kai tsaye kan wannan gibi.

Inside Higher Ed · Established press report on industry usage data

entry.title: UNESCO programme trains over 100 rural teachers and principals across China and Southeast Asia in AI and STEM
entry.summary:
UNESCO ta bayar da rahoto a ranar 30 ga Satumba 2026 cewa Shirinta na Gina Ƙarfin Malamai da Shugabannin Makarantu na China da Kudu maso Gabashin Asiya, wanda aka gudanar a Beijing daga 17 zuwa 23 ga Agusta 2026 ƙarƙashin taken 'STEM da AI: Ƙarfafa Malaman Karkara don Sauyin Dijital', ya tattaro masu tsara manufofin ilimi, shugabannin makarantu, malamai da ƙwararru sama da 100 daga China da ƙasashen Kudu maso Gabashin Asiya. An shirya shi tare da Cibiyar Bincike da Horarwa ta Ƙasa da Ƙasa kan Ilimin Karkara ta UNESCO, SEAMEO RECSAM, Kujerar UNESCO kan Ƙirƙirarriyar Basira a Ilimi a Beijing Normal University da OECD, kuma shirin ya mai da hankali kan amfani da AI da koyar da STEM don inganta daidaiton dijital a al'ummomin karkara da ba a yi wa hidima sosai ba. Farfesa Shahbaz Khan, daraktan Ofishin UNESCO na Yankin Gabashin Asiya, ya yi kira ga 'AI a ilimi wanda ya sa ɗan'adam a gaba, mai ɗa'a kuma mai haɗa kowa'.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 3, AI da nazarin bayanai a STEM da horar da malamai, nacewar shirin cewa fasaha za ta iya tallafa wa malaman karkara amma ba za ta taɓa maye gurbinsu ba ya ba da samfurin da Wits AHEAD za ta iya amfani da shi a aikinta na shirya masu horar da malamai a sassan Kudancin Duniya marasa wadataccen kayan aiki.

UNESCO · Intergovernmental body

entry.title: Ethiopia's Education Ministry says AI will support, not replace, teachers as it expands digital learning
entry.summary:
Ministan Ilimi na Habasha, Berhanu Nega, ya ce a ranar 29 ga Satumba 2026 cewa ana tallafa wa malamai a faɗin ƙasar don amfani da ƙirƙirarriyar basira wajen shirya darussa, samar da abun ciki, tallafa wa ɗalibai da tantancewa, tare da mayar da Tsarin Bayanan Gudanar da Ilimi da na Manyan Makarantu na ma'aikatar zuwa na dijital. Ministan ya jaddada cewa ana kawo AI ne don ƙarfafa ƙwarewar malamai ba don maye gurbinsu ba, a matsayin wani ɓangare na yunƙuri mafi faɗi kan koyo ta intanet, koyo mai gauraye da ƙananan takardun shaida, da kuma ƙarfafa haɗin dijital ga jami'o'i da makarantu. Ya yi kira ga tsarin ilimi da ya wuce haddace karatu ya kuma samar da masu tunani mai zurfi da za su iya 'aiki tare da injuna'.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, da ginshiƙi na 5, nazarin bayanai da bayanai don tsarin ilimi, ma'aikatar ƙasa da ta yi alƙawari a bainar jama'a cewa AI zai zama tallafi ga malamai ba madadinsu ba, tare da gyaran bayanai a matakin tsari, irin alamar manufa ce da Wits AHEAD ke bibiya a faɗin Kudancin Duniya.

allAfrica (Ethiopian News Agency) · National press, government ministry announcement

entry.title: Africa must build its own AI solutions rather than import them, says UN scientific panel member
entry.summary:
Girmaw Abebe Tadesse, wanda ke jagorantar Ɗakin Gwaji na Microsoft na AI for Good a Kenya kuma memba ne na Kwamitin Kimiyya Mai Zaman Kansa na Ƙasa da Ƙasa na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya kan Ƙirƙirarriyar Basira, ya shaida wa UN News a lokacin Babban Makon Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya a New York a ranar 25 ga Satumba 2026 cewa ya kamata ƙasashen Afirka su gano matsalolinsu da kansu kafin su rungumi fasahar da aka ƙera a wasu wurare. Ya ce masu ruwa da tsaki, ciki har da manyan makarantu, gwamnatoci, abokan ci gaba da kamfanonin fasaha, ya kamata su haɗa iliminsu don gina mafita da suka dace da yanayin gida maimakon maimaita ƙoƙari, kuma ya ambaci yawan matasan Afirka a matsayin tushen ƙirƙira da tuni ke amfani da fasaha wajen magance ƙalubalen al'umma.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai alhaki, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, ambaton jami'o'i a fili da wani mai ba da shawara kan kimiyya na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ya yi a matsayin muhimman abokan hulɗa a ajandar AI da 'yan gida ke jagoranta yana ƙarfafa hujjar Wits AHEAD na mai da hankali kan bincike da mafita mallakar Afirka, ba tsarin da aka shigo da su daga waje ba.

allAfrica (UN News) · UN News Service, intergovernmental body

entry.title: Cape Town hosts first African THE World Academic Summit as Wits and four other South African universities rise in the world rankings
entry.summary:
An buɗe Babban Taron Ilimi na Duniya na Times Higher Education a University of Cape Town a ranar 30 ga Satumba 2026, karo na farko da aka gudanar da taron a nahiyar Afirka, tare da ƙaddamar da Matsayin Jami'o'in Duniya na THE na 2027. Jami'o'in Afirka ta Kudu biyar yanzu suna cikin 500 mafi kyau a duniya, ciki har da Wits a matsayi na 301 zuwa 325, yayin da University of Cape Town ta haura zuwa matsayi na 147 tare da wata, mafi kyawun matsayinta cikin shekaru bakwai. Mataimakin shugaban UCT, Mosa Moshabela, ya ce jami'ar ta kashe kayan aikinta na gano AI don mai da hankali kan koya wa ɗalibai yadda za su yi amfani da AI yadda ya kamata, yayin da Ministan Manyan Makarantu, Buti Manamela, ya lura cewa matasa shida cikin goma na Afirka ta Kudu ba su da aikin yi.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, matakin UCT na barin gano AI don koyar da amfani da shi yadda ya kamata yana nuna sauyi a manufofin tantancewa da Wits AHEAD ke bibiya a dukkan fannin, kuma hauhawar matsayi tare da alƙaluman Ministan kan rashin aikin yi suna jaddada dalilin da ya sa AI, nazarin bayanai da ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu ke da muhimmanci ga kowace jami'ar Afirka ta Kudu, har da Wits.

Daily Maverick · Established press

entry.title: Alliance for African Partnership meets in Dar es Salaam and puts AI skills at the centre of regional cooperation

category.term: Africa (Tanzania, hosted by the University of Dar es Salaam)

entry.summary:
Alliance for African Partnership, ƙungiyar haɗin gwiwa ta jami'o'i 12 daga ƙasashen Afirka 10 wadda Michigan State University ke jagoranta, ta gudanar da taronta na shekara ta 2026 a Jami'ar Dar es Salaam daga 16 zuwa 22 ga Satumba. Mataimakin Shugaban Jami'a mai kula da Bincike, Nelson Boniface, ya shaida wa wakilai cewa dole ne jami'o'i su sabunta manhajojinsu kuma su horar da malamai don kada AI ya bar waɗanda suka kammala karatu a baya, yana ƙara da cewa ilimin AI yanzu ƙwarewa ce da kowane ɗalibi ke buƙata, ba masana kimiyyar kwamfuta kaɗai ba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 4, ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, kiran ƙungiyar na gyaran manhaja da horar da malamai a ƙasashen Afirka goma ya yi daidai da hujjar Wits AHEAD na shigar da ilimin AI a kowane fanni, ba STEM kaɗai ba, don waɗanda suka kammala karatu a Afirka su ci gaba da samun aikin yi.

allAfrica.com, from the Daily News (Tanzania) · Established African news service

entry.title: Morgan State University wins 10 million dollar federal grant to build a trusted AI research institute
entry.summary:
Morgan State University, jami'ar Baƙar fata ta tarihi a Baltimore, ta karɓi dala miliyan 10 na tallafin gwamnatin tarayyar Amurka don kafa Cibiyar Hanyoyin Sadarwa Masu Zaman Kansu Amintattu, wadda aka fi sani da TITAN, kamar yadda sanatocin Amurka Chris Van Hollen da Angela Alsobrooks suka sanar a ranar 16 ga Satumba 2026. Tallafin na shekaru biyar yana ɗaukar nauyin bincike da horar da ɗaliban digiri na uku a fannin AI, tsaron intanet da tsaro da fasahar kwantum ke ƙarfafawa, kuma an yi niyya ne don taimaka wa Morgan State ta kai matakin koli na jami'o'in bincike na Amurka.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 3, AI da nazarin bayanai a STEM da horar da malamai, mayar da hankalin TITAN kan horar da masu binciken digiri na uku a jami'ar Baƙar fata ta tarihi yana nuna yadda tallafin da aka keɓe don binciken AI zai iya faɗaɗa waɗanda ke jagorantar binciken AI, tambayar da Wits AHEAD ke bibiya don adalci a STEM a duniya.

CBS News Baltimore · Established press

entry.title: MIT trains faculty from other universities to teach AI across disciplines
entry.summary:
MIT Stephen A. Schwarzman College of Computing ta gwada taron bita na mako guda da ke horar da malamai daga sauran kwalejoji da jami'o'i don koyar da AI da koyon na'ura a cikin fannoninsu, ta amfani da kayan da aka daidaita daga kwas ɗin MIT na "Modelling with Machine Learning". Taron farko a watan Yuli 2026 ya tattaro malaman jami'a 19 daga cibiyoyi bakwai, ciki har da Allen University, Babson College, Brandeis University da University of Massachusetts at Lowell, tare da malaman MIT fiye da shida da suka gabatar da zama kan harkokin kuɗi, kimiyyar kwamfuta da dorewa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 3, AI da nazarin bayanai a STEM da horar da malamai, gwajin yana magance wani cikas da Wits AHEAD ma ke fuskanta: malaman jami'a da ke wajen kimiyyar kwamfuta suna buƙatar horo na aikace kafin su iya koyar da ilimin AI cikin gaskiya a fannoninsu.

MIT News · University announcement

entry.title: UNESCO survey finds most Latin American and Caribbean universities use AI, but few have a strategy
entry.summary:
Cibiyar Ƙasa da Ƙasa ta UNESCO kan Manyan Makarantu a Latin Amurka da Caribbean (IESALC), tare da Cibiyar Nazari Mai Zurfi kan Dorewa ta Jami'ar Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya, ta gudanar da binciken jin ra'ayi a manyan makarantu 200 a ƙasashe 19 kuma ta wallafa sakamakonsa a ranar 8 ga Satumba 2026 a lokacin Makon Koyo na Dijital na UNESCO. Ta gano cewa kashi 87 cikin ɗari na cibiyoyi tuni suna amfani da AI a aƙalla ɓangare ɗaya na aikinsu, galibi a koyarwa da koyo, amma kashi 26 cikin ɗari ne kawai ke da tsarin dabarun AI na hukuma. Yawancin shirye-shiryen AI suna farawa ne daga malaman jami'a, masu bincike ko ɗalibai ɗaiɗai maimakon shugabancin cibiya.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai alhaki, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, gibin da ke tsakanin amfani da AI kusan a ko'ina da gudanarwa ta hukuma a Latin Amurka da Caribbean yana kama da yanayin da Wits AHEAD ke bibiya a faɗin Kudancin Duniya, inda aikin yau da kullum ke gaba da manufofin cibiyoyi.

UNESCO IESALC and United Nations University · Intergovernmental higher education body report

entry.title: University of Colorado system adopts a living policy for responsible use of AI
entry.summary:
Sabuwar Sanarwar Manufar Gudanarwa ta 6012 ta tsarin University of Colorado, Amfani da Ƙirƙirarriyar Basira cikin Alhaki, ta fara aiki a ranar 24 ga Agusta 2026 kuma an bayyana ta a shafin manufofin jami'ar a ranar 21 ga Satumba. Tana kafa abubuwan da ake tsammani a dukkan tsarin kan gaskiya a ilimi, kare bayanai, bayyana gaskiya da tabbatar da ingancin abun ciki da AI ya samar, kuma an gabatar da ita a fili a matsayin manufar da za ta riƙa sauyawa yayin da ra'ayoyi ke zuwa daga ɗalibai da ma'aikata.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiya, babban tsarin jami'o'in gwamnati da ya zaɓi ɗaukar ƙa'idojinsa na AI a matsayin takarda mai rai maimakon manufa mara sauyi abin kwatantawa ne daga Arewacin Duniya ga zaɓuɓɓukan gudanarwa da Wits AHEAD ke bibiya a Kudancin Duniya.

University of Colorado · University policy announcement

entry.title: University of Pretoria trains future teachers in "prompt literacy" for the AI classroom
entry.summary:
Masu bincike a Sashen Ilimin Yara Ƙanana na University of Pretoria, ƙarƙashin jagorancin Dr Joyce West da Dr Kayla Willemse, suna gudanar da bincike mai matakai da yawa kan ƙwarewar ba da umarni, wato iya ba AI mai samar da abun ciki bayyanannun umarni tare da yin hukunci mai zurfi kan abin da yake samarwa. Aikin yana horar da malamai na gaba don amfani da AI a matsayin kayan aikin haɗin gwiwa a aji maimakon barazana, ta ayyuka kamar gina labaran yara da kayan dijital, tare da sa ido sosai kan son kai, kurakurai da haƙƙin mallaka a cikin abin da AI ke samarwa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 3, AI da nazarin bayanai a STEM da horar da malamai, binciken yana magance wani gibi da Wits AHEAD ke bibiya sosai: ko ana koya wa sabbin malamai yadda za su tambayi sakamakon AI, ba yadda za su samar da shi kaɗai ba.

Future SA, reporting University of Pretoria research · South African higher education press, reporting university research

entry.title: East African universities and Arizona State University partner to build "AI-ready" higher education
entry.summary:
Majalisar Jami'o'in Gabashin Afirka, hukumar manyan makarantu ta Ƙungiyar Ƙasashen Gabashin Afirka, ta sanar a ranar 9 ga Satumba 2026 da haɗin gwiwa tare da University Design Institute na Arizona State University don taimaka wa jami'o'in Gabashin Afirka su shirya wa AI. Aikin ya ƙunshi fannoni huɗu: shugabanci da gudanarwa, bunƙasa malamai, tsarin bincike da koyo tsakanin cibiyoyi. Cibiyar Zane tana kawo ƙwarewa daga ƙasashe 26 da cibiyoyi fiye da 140, ciki har da bakwai a Afirka.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 5, nazarin bayanai da bayanai don tsarin ilimi da yanke shawara, haɗin gwiwar yana nuna hukumar manyan makarantu ta yanki tana gina ƙarfin AI a jami'o'i da yawa a lokaci guda, samfurin da Wits AHEAD za ta iya kwatanta shi da nata isar a Kudancin Afirka.

Inter-University Council for East Africa · Intergovernmental higher education body announcement

entry.title: Maharashtra sets up a state committee to govern AI and data dashboards across its universities
entry.summary:
Sashen Manyan Makarantu da Ilimin Fasaha na Maharashtra ya fitar da ƙudurin gwamnati da ke kafa Kwamitin Gudanar da AI, Nazarin Bayanai da Allon Bayanai, ƙarƙashin jagorancin Farfesa Rajnish Kamat, mataimakin shugaban Shivaji University, Kolhapur. A tsawon wa'adinsa na shekaru uku, kwamitin mai membobi tara dole ne ya tsara dabarun AI na jiha, ya zaɓi muhimman amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki, koyon na'ura da sarrafa harshen ɗan'adam, ya daidaita bayanai a cikin allunan bayanan da jihar ke da su na ɗalibai, jarrabawa da tallafin karatu, kuma ya gina nazarin yanayi da hasashen haɗari masu aiki da kansu a cikin dandalin da a yanzu kawai yake ba da rahoton alƙaluma, tare da bin ƙa'idojin tsaron intanet da sirri. Yana kai rahoto kowane wata uku ga manyan ma'aikatan gwamnati na sashen.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 5, nazarin bayanai da bayanai don tsarin ilimi da yanke shawara, wannan yana ɗaya daga cikin gwamnatocin jihohi na farko a ko'ina da suka ɗora kwamiti na dindindin mai alhaki don mayar da allon rahoto ya zama ainihin tsarin gargaɗi da wuri da tallafin yanke shawara, samfurin da Wits AHEAD za ta iya nuni da shi yayin da take kira ga irin wannan sauyi a Afirka ta Kudu.

Government of Maharashtra, Higher and Technical Education Department · State government resolution, reported by regional press

entry.title: Telkom Foundation, BCX and Alibaba Cloud partner with Wits to give students AI-powered coding tools
entry.summary:
Telkom Foundation, BCX da Alibaba Cloud sun haɗa kai da University of the Witwatersrand don ba wa kusan ɗaliban Kimiyyar Kwamfuta na shekara ta uku 165 damar amfani da dandalin haɓaka manhaja na Qoder na Alibaba mai amfani da AI don ayyukan manhajarsu na ilimi. Shirin Qoder na nufin ba wa ɗalibai ƙwarewa ta aikace a kayan aikin rubuta manhaja da AI ke taimakawa kafin su shiga wurin aiki inda irin waɗannan kayan aiki suka zama ruwan dare, da ƙarfafa alaƙa tsakanin manhajar karatun Wits da aikin masana'antu. Farfesa Richard Klein, shugaban Wits School of Computer Science and Applied Mathematics, ya ce manhajar karatu na buƙatar sauyawa tare da waɗannan ci gaban na duniya.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 4, ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, wannan mataki ne na zahiri da Wits da kanta ta ɗauka don cike gibin da ke tsakanin abin da waɗanda suka kammala karatun kimiyyar kwamfuta ke koya da ayyukan injiniyancin manhaja da AI ke ƙarfafawa da za su shiga, a matakin da Wits AHEAD za ta iya bibiya kuma ta gina a kai.

Wits University · University announcement

entry.title: Systematic review of 124 studies finds AI's value in education depends on governance, not the technology, and flags a Global South research gap

category.term: Global (evidence base: Central Asia, East Africa)

entry.summary:
Wani bita na tsari da masu bincike a jami'o'in Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan da Tanzania suka gudanar ya haɗa bincike 124 da aka wallafa tsakanin Janairu 2020 da Janairu 2026 kan yadda AI ke sauya ilimi. Ya gano sauyi na gaske amma mara daidaito daga kayan aikin AI ɗaiɗai zuwa koyarwa mafi sassauci da ke dogara da bayanai, kuma ya kammala cewa ko wannan sauyin zai taimaka ko zai cutar da masu koyo ya dogara ne kan gudanarwa da yanayin cibiya ba kan fasahar kanta ba, kuma dole ne hukuncin ɗan'adam da matsayin malami su ci gaba da kasancewa a tsakiya maimakon ɗaukar AI a matsayin hukuma mai cin gashin kanta. Marubutan sun kuma gano cewa tushen shaidun kansa ya karkata sosai ga wallafe-wallafen harshen Turanci, yayin da ra'ayoyin Kudancin Duniya, na 'yan asali da na harsuna da yawa har yanzu ba su da yawa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai alhaki, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, wannan tabbaci ne da masana suka tantance, daga masu bincike da ke Tsakiyar Asiya da Gabashin Afirka da kansu, na ainihin gibin shaida da ke motsa aikin Wits AHEAD: rubuce-rubucen da ya kamata su jagoranci manufofin AI a ilimi da ƙyar suke ɗauke da muryoyin Kudancin Duniya da ya kamata su jagorance su.

Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Business schools bring back oral defences as AI use rises
entry.summary:
Manyan makarantun kasuwanci na Turai, ciki har da Insead, Imperial College Business School da HEC Paris, suna dawo da kare aiki da baki, jarrabawar alƙalami da takarda da tantancewa a ƙarƙashin kulawa ta kusa saboda AI mai samar da abun ciki ya raunana nazarin misali na yau da kullum da ake yi a gida. Peter Todd na Imperial ya ce ma'aikata ba za su iya tabbatar da abin da rubutaccen aiki ke wakilta ba sai ɗalibai sun kare shi gaban mutane ko sun rubuta shi a ƙarƙashin kulawa, kuma HEC Paris yanzu tana musanya tsakanin tantancewa da kwamfuta da kuma ba tare da ita ba. Graduate Management Admission Council ta ce ƙa'idojin tantancewa na buƙatar ƙarin bayyana idan ana son takardun shaidar kasuwanci su riƙe ma'anarsu.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 1, AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu, wannan yana nuna manyan makarantun kasuwanci suna barin tantancewar gida gaba ɗaya maimakon gyara ta, abin da ya shafi kai tsaye yadda Wits AHEAD ke tsara jagororin gaskiyar tantancewa ga jami'o'in Afirka da ke fuskantar irin wannan matsin lamba da ƙarancin kayan aiki sosai don jarrabawar baki ko ta kulawa.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press

entry.title: African curriculum experts meet in Dar es Salaam to confront the AI challenge in teacher education
entry.summary:
An gudanar da Taro na Shida na Ƙungiyar Manhajar Karatu ta Afirka a Dar es Salaam daga 22 zuwa 25 ga Satumba 2026, wanda ya tattaro masu tsara manhaja, masu horar da malamai, masu bincike da masu tsara manufofi daga faɗin nahiyar. Babban daraktan Cibiyar Ilimi ta Tanzania, Dr Aneth Komba, da babbar sakatariyar ƙungiyar, Dr Gertrude Namubiru, sun jagoranci tattaunawa kan yadda manhajojin Afirka da shirya malamai dole su daidaita da AI da saurin sauyin fasaha yayin da suke ci gaba da kasancewa a kan ƙwarewar gida da bukatun al'umma. Taron ya yi niyyar fitar da Sanarwar Dar es Salaam kan Sauyin Ilimi a Afirka, wadda ta yi daidai da Ajanda 2063 ta Tarayyar Afirka da Muradi na huɗu na Ci Gaba Mai Ɗorewa.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 3, AI da nazarin bayanai a STEM da horar da malamai, taron nahiyar baki ɗaya da ke bayyana yadda shirya malamai da kansa dole ya sauya don ajin da AI ke tsarawa yana magana kai tsaye kan aikin Wits AHEAD game da abin da masu horar da malamai ke buƙatar sani, ba abin da ya kamata a koya wa yara da ɗalibai kaɗai ba.

The Citizen (Tanzania) · Established national press

entry.title: Universities must teach people to work ‘with AI, not for AI’, says King's College London head
entry.summary:
Yayin da yake jawabi a Babban Taron Duniya na Korea Times na 2026 a Seoul, mataimakin shugaban King's College London, Shitij Kapur, ya ce dole ne jami'o'i su tabbatar mutane suna aiki tare da AI maimakon yi masa aiki. Ya bayyana ayyuka biyar na jami'o'i: sake fayyace ma'anar koyo, shirya waɗanda suka kammala karatu don kasuwar ƙwadago mai sauyawa, kare ilimi mai zurfin tunani, ciyar da AI gaba don amfanin gama gari da tabbatar da cewa fasahar tana ƙarfafa ƙwarewar ɗan'adam maimakon maye gurbinta. Kapur ya ce ci gaban AI ba ƙaddara ba ce, kuma jami'o'i da ƙasashe har yanzu za su iya tsara yadda ake gina shi da amfani da shi maimakon karɓarsa kawai daga masana'antar fasaha.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai alhaki, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, babban mataimakin shugaban jami'a da ya sanya jami'o'i a tsakiyar tsara AI maimakon kawai mayar da martani gare shi yana goyon bayan hujjar Wits AHEAD cewa manyan makarantun Kudancin Duniya ya kamata su taimaka wajen tsara sharuɗɗan amfani da AI, ba kawai su karɓi kayan aikin da aka gina a wani wuri ba.

University World News · Established higher education press

entry.title: Latin America's universities embrace AI faster than they can govern it, new study finds
entry.summary:
Wani bincike na UNESCO IESALC kan manyan makarantu 200 a ƙasashe 19 na Latin Amurka da Caribbean ya gano cewa kashi 87 cikin ɗari tuni suna amfani da AI a wani ɓangare na aikinsu, amma kashi 26 cikin ɗari ne kawai ke da kowane tsarin AI na hukuma. Amfani ya fi yawa a jami'o'i masu zaman kansu marasa riba, a kashi 84 cikin ɗari, idan aka kwatanta da kashi 68 cikin ɗari a cibiyoyin gwamnati da kashi 52 cikin ɗari a masu zaman kansu masu riba, kuma kashi 55 cikin ɗari na jami'o'i gaba ɗaya ba su da kasafin kuɗi na musamman don AI. Borhene Chakroun na UNESCO ya ce samun mafi girman amfani ya dogara ne kan ci gaba da zuba jari a samun dama da iyawa, tare da gudanarwa da ke tabbatar da amfani cikin ɗa'a, bayyana gaskiya da alhaki.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai alhaki, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, wannan yana nuna gibin da Wits AHEAD ke gargaɗi a kai yana kafuwa a babban mataki: jami'o'in gwamnati, waɗanda ke hidima ga ɗaliban da ke da mafi ƙarancin zaɓi, suna rungumar AI a aji da sauri fiye da kowa yayin da suke baya sosai a gudanarwa, horo da kuɗin amfani da shi cikin alhaki.

Times Higher Education · Established higher education press, reporting a UNESCO IESALC study

entry.title: African universities can drive talent development at scale, Mastercard Foundation tells Accra convening
entry.summary:
A Taron farko na Sauyin Manyan Makarantu a Accra a ranar 22 ga Satumba 2026, Dr John Nkengasong na Mastercard Foundation ya bayyana jami'o'in Afirka a matsayin 'injunan wadata' da ginshiƙin jarin ɗan'adam da dole ne su daidaita koyarwa da kasuwannin ƙwadago da masana'antu. Taron ya karrama cibiyoyi biyar da Kyautar Manyan Makarantun Afirka don Sauyi (AHEFT): Addis Ababa University, 2iE, Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Muni University da University of Rwanda. Gidauniyar ta sake jaddada burinta na taimaka wa matasan Afirka miliyan 30, kashi 70 cikin ɗari daga cikinsu mata, su samu aiki mai mutunci nan da 2030.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 4, ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, babban mai ba da tallafi da ya bayyana jami'o'i a matsayin ginshiƙin baiwa, yayin da ya ambaci AI a matsayin ƙarfin da ke sauya aiki, yana ƙarfafa muhimmancin shaidun Wits AHEAD kan waɗanne ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu ne ke kai wa ga aiki mai mutunci a kasuwannin ƙwadagon Afirka.

University World News · Established higher education press

entry.title: 'Syncopathy' and AI: African HE must choose verification
entry.summary:
A rubutunsa a University World News, Dr Kende Kefale na University of Cape Town ya ƙirƙiri kalmar 'syncopathy' don sakamakon AI, kamar ambato da hujjoji, da ke kama da gaskiya amma suka tsallake tantancewa, kuma ya ce jami'o'i suna da irin wannan aibi saboda duba aiki yana da tsada kuma ba a gani, yayin da samar da sakamako ke da arha kuma da sauƙin ƙirgawa. Ya ba da shawarar cibiyoyi su bayyana yawan aikin da ɗan'adam ke dubawa kafin a ba da takardun shaida, kowane tsarin ganowa mai aiki da kansa ya kasance da wani mutum da aka ambata mai alhakin kurakuransa, kuma bayanan tantancewa su zama sakamako na dindindin na cibiya. Ya yi nuni da daftarin Manufar AI ta Ƙasa ta Afirka ta Kudu, wadda aka janye a watan Afrilu 2026 bayan an gano ambato na ƙarya a jerin manazartarta.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai alhaki, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, hujjar ta ba Wits AHEAD tsarin aiki na gudanar da AI a jami'o'in Afirka, wanda ya ɗora nauyin kuɗin tantancewa da alhakin hukunce-hukuncen da injuna ke yankewa a kan cibiyoyi maimakon ɗalibai.

University World News · Commentary by a University of Cape Town academic in established higher education press

entry.title: From AI use to funding cuts: how provosts are navigating 2026
entry.summary:
Binciken jin ra'ayi na Inside Higher Ed na 2026 kan manyan jami'an ilimi 376, wanda Hanover Research ta gudanar, ya gano cewa kusan bakwai cikin goma daga cikinsu suna amfani da AI a aikinsu aƙalla sau ɗaya a mako, amma ɗaya kawai cikin goma ya ce cibiyarsa tana da tsarin dabarun AI na bai ɗaya. Kashi 12 cikin ɗari ne kawai suka ba da rahoton ingantuwar tafiyar aiki a sassa daga zuba jarin cibiya a AI, kuma kashi 8 cikin ɗari sauyi a dukkan cibiya, yayin da kashi 15 cikin ɗari ba su zuba jari ko kaɗan ba. Ƙwarewa da ƙarfin ma'aikata (kashi 51 cikin ɗari) da turjiyar malamai da ma'aikata (kashi 50 cikin ɗari) su ne manyan cikas da aka ambata.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 5, nazarin bayanai da bayanai don tsarin ilimi da yanke shawara, gibin da ke tsakanin amfanin shugabanni da AI na ƙashin kansu da dabarun cibiya shi ne ainihin fagen da Wits AHEAD ke kira ga yanke shawara a matakin tsari bisa shaida game da AI a jami'o'i.

Inside Higher Ed · Established higher education press; national survey fielded by Hanover Research

entry.title: Record number of graduates pushes youth unemployment to 18.9%
entry.summary:
Rashin aikin yi a birane tsakanin matasa masu shekaru 16 zuwa 24 a China, ban da ɗalibai, ya ƙaru zuwa kashi 18.9 cikin ɗari a watan Agusta 2026 daga kashi 17.9 cikin ɗari a watan Yuli, bisa alƙaluman Hukumar Kididdiga ta Ƙasa da University World News ta ruwaito. Ƙaruwar ta biyo bayan adadin da ba a taɓa gani ba na waɗanda suka kammala jami'a miliyan 12.7 a wannan damina, kuma ita ce mafi girma tun da aka sauya hanyar ƙididdiga a 2023. Rahoton ya ambaci raunin buƙata a cikin gida da ƙaruwar amfani da AI a matsayin matsin lamba kan ɗaukar ma'aikatan matakin farko.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 4, ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci, matsin da waɗanda suka kammala karatu ke fuskanta a China yana nuna cewa faɗaɗa manyan makarantu kaɗai ba ya tabbatar da shiga aiki yayin da AI ke sauya ayyukan matakin farko, darasin da Wits AHEAD za ta auna da kasuwannin ƙwadagon waɗanda suka kammala karatu a Afirka ta Kudu da faɗin Kudancin Duniya.

University World News (from the South China Morning Post) · Established higher education press reporting national statistics

entry.title: Ten-country African university alliance pushes joint research and AI skills
entry.summary:
Alliance for Africa Partnership, ƙungiyar haɗin gwiwa ta cibiyoyi 12 a ƙasashen Afirka 10 wadda Michigan State University ke jagoranta, ta yi amfani da taronta na shekara a Dar es Salaam a ranar 22 ga Satumba 2026 don yin kira ga ƙarin bincike na haɗin gwiwa da kuma jami'o'i su shigar da ƙwarewar AI cikin manhajojinsu. Farfesa Nelson Boniface na Jami'ar Dar es Salaam ya shaida wa wakilai cewa ƙwarewar AI yanzu ita ce abin da ake buƙata na farko ga kowane wanda ya kammala karatu, ba masu rubuta manhaja kaɗai ba, kuma ya buƙaci ƙarfafa alaƙa tsakanin jami'o'i, masana'antu da gwamnati don mayar da bincike zuwa magance matsaloli a aikace.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na 4 ya shafi AI, ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci. Ƙungiyar jami'o'in Afirka ta ƙasashe goma da ta sanya ƙwarewar AI da bincike na haɗin gwiwa a cikin ajandarta, ba tare da jiran tsare-tsare daga waje ba, misali ne mai rai na haɗin gwiwar ƙetare iyaka da Wits AHEAD ke nazari, kuma tunatarwa ce cewa ana magance gibin ƙwarewar nahiyar daga ciki.

Tanzania Daily News, via allAfrica · African press wire service

entry.title: Report warns AI adoption in US colleges is outpacing student safeguards
entry.summary:
Wani sabon rahoto daga shirin SHAPE na Student Defense, wanda Inside Higher Ed ta ruwaito a ranar 18 ga Satumba 2026, ya gano cewa kwalejojin Amurka sun shigar da AI cikin ɗaukar ɗalibai, tallafin kuɗi, ba da shawara da koyarwa da sauri fiye da yadda suka gina matakan kare ɗalibai. Ya bayyana son kai na algorithm a shawarwarin tallafi, gibin sirrin bayanai da ɓacewar al'ummomin koyo na gaske a matsayin manyan haɗurra, kuma ya yi kira ga cibiyoyi su kafa bayyanannun ƙa'idojin gudanarwa da bayyana gaskiya kafin su ci gaba da amfani da tsarin AI.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai alhaki, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, rahoton jerin abubuwan dubawa ne na zahiri na inda gudanar da AI a manyan makarantu ke baya ga aiki, mai amfani wajen gwada jagororin Wits AHEAD kan bayyana gaskiya da alhaki da tsarin da ya yi nisa a amfani da AI.

Inside Higher Ed · Established higher education press

entry.title: UNESCO: over 25 education ministers declare AI must serve the 'common good'
entry.summary:
Ministocin ilimi da manyan jami'ai fiye da 25 da suka hallara a Makon Koyo na Dijital na UNESCO a Paris sun amince da sanarwar haɗin gwiwa a ranar 8 ga Satumba 2026 da ke cewa dole ne ilimi ya ci gaba da kasancewa haƙƙin ɗan'adam kuma amfanin gama gari yayin da AI ke yaɗuwa a azuzuwa da jami'o'i. Sanarwar ta zayyana muhimman abubuwa takwas, ciki har da tabbatar da cewa ana iya duba tsarin AI kuma suna ƙarƙashin kulawar jama'a, da kare muryar malamai kan fasahar aji. Ta ambaci wani binciken UNESCO inda kashi 93 cikin ɗari na malaman jami'a suka yarda cewa ɗalibai suna amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki wajen yin ayyukansu, kuma kashi 63 cikin ɗari sun lura da raguwar ƙarfin tunanin ɗalibai.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Don ginshiƙi na 6, AI mai alhaki, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi, sanarwar ministoci ta wannan girma tana ba Wits AHEAD ma'auni da aka amince da shi a matakin ƙasa da ƙasa na yadda alhakin jama'a a gudanar da AI ya kamata ya kasance, wanda jami'o'i da masu tsara manufofin ƙasa a Kudancin Duniya za su iya ambato kai tsaye.

UNESCO · UN agency ministerial statement

entry.title: University of Alaska regents weigh a system-wide AI policy for every campus
entry.summary:
Kwamitin Amintattu na University of Alaska ya duba daftarin manufar AI da za ta wajabta wa dukkan harabarsa uku su samar da shirin aiwatar da AI ga ɗalibai, ma'aikata da malamai. Daftarin ya shimfiɗa ƙa'idojin jagora kan kiyaye hukuncin ɗan'adam, kare sirri da tsaron bayanai, da amfani da AI don faɗaɗa samun hidimomin ilimi, tare da zaman karɓar ra'ayoyi da aka tsara a tsawon kaka ta 2026 da kuma niyyar amincewa ta ƙarshe a taron amintattu na Nuwamba.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na 6 ya shafi AI mai alhaki, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi. Tsarin jami'ar gwamnati da ke gina gudanar da AI tun daga tushe, a bainar jama'a kuma amintattu na tambayar ƙarfin sa ido, samfurin gudanarwa ne mai amfani da Wits AHEAD za ta bibiya yayin da take haɓaka jagororin manufofinta.

Alaska Public Media · Public broadcaster report

entry.title: World Bank opens free AI skills training to young people across 44 African countries
entry.summary:
Bankin Duniya ya ƙaddamar da shirin 'The Job I Hope For', yana gayyatar matasa masu shekaru 18 zuwa sama a ƙasashe 44 na Afirka Kudu da Sahara su yi rajista don horo kyauta ta intanet kan tushen AI mai samar da abun ciki, rubuta umarni da ɗa'ar AI, wanda za a gabatar da Turanci da Faransanci a watan Oktoba 2026. Shirin yana amsa yanayin nahiyar da ake sa ran matasa fiye da miliyan 600 za su shiga kasuwar ƙwadago nan da 2050, yana tambayar mahalarta su fara bayyana sana'ar da suke fata kafin su gina ƙwarewar AI da za ta kai su gare ta.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na 4 ya shafi AI, ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu, samun aikin yi da sauye-sauye masu adalci. Shirin ƙwarewar AI kyauta na nahiyar baki ɗaya da aka yi wa matasan da ke shiga aiki kai tsaye gwaji ne kai tsaye na yadda za a iya gina horo a babban mataki don kasuwannin ƙwadagon da Wits AHEAD ke nazari, kuma abokin hulɗa ko samfurin da ya kamata a bibiya.

World Bank · Intergovernmental body brief

entry.title: Systematic review finds AI training for future primary maths teachers is still too brief to stick
entry.summary:
Wani bita na tsari da masu bincike a jami'o'in Portugal uku suka gudanar ya duba bincike 11 da masana suka tantance kan yadda ake horar da malaman firamare masu horo don amfani da AI a koyar da lissafi. Yawancin horon gajerun zama ne da aka liƙa a kan kwasa-kwasan da ake da su maimakon darussa masu ɗorewa, kuma sun ƙunshi sanin AI da amfaninsa a aikace da kyau amma ɗa'a da kimantawa mai zurfi ba tare da daidaito ba, abin da ya bar ƙaramar shaida cewa ƙwarewar tana shiga azuzuwa na gaske.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na 3 ya shafi AI da nazarin bayanai a STEM da horar da malamai. Muhimman fannoni huɗu na bitar, wato sani, ilimi da rubuta umarni, haɗawa da koyarwa da kimantawa mai zurfi, suna ba Wits AHEAD jerin abubuwan dubawa na zahiri don tsara aikinta na horar da malamai maimakon taron bita ɗaya na AI.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed systematic review

entry.title: New scale measures students' skill at using AI responsibly in assessed work
entry.summary:
Masu bincike a cibiyoyi uku a China sun ƙirƙiri kuma sun tabbatar da ma'auni mai abubuwa goma sha takwas da ke auna yadda ɗaliban manyan makarantu ke fahimtar sharuɗɗan tantancewa, bayyana amfaninsu da AI da kiyaye gaskiya a ilimi yayin amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki a ayyukan kwas. Bayan an gwada shi da ɗalibai 486 sannan wani rukuni na daban na 798, ma'aunin ya nuna tsari mai inganci na ɓangarori biyar kuma yana da alaƙa mai ƙarfi da yadda ɗalibai ke amfani da ra'ayoyin da aka ba su da niyyarsu ta aikata gaskiya.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na 1 ya shafi AI mai samar da abun ciki a manyan makarantu: koyarwa, tantancewa da gaskiya. Kayan aiki da aka tabbatar kamar wannan yana ba cibiyoyi hanyar aikace ta auna da gina ilimin tantancewa na ɗalibai, maimakon dogaro da manhajar ganowa ko hani gaba ɗaya kawai.

Frontiers in Education · Peer-reviewed journal article

entry.title: Prescriptive AI model flags Ecuadorian students at highest dropout risk, and what would change it
entry.summary:
Masu bincike a wata jami'ar gwamnati a Ecuador sun gina tsarin nazarin bayanai mai ba da shawara, suna bibiyar ɗalibai 2,500 da suka shiga tsakanin 2020 da 2024, wanda ba wai kawai ya yi hasashen haɗarin barin karatu da daidaito mai girma ba (ROC-AUC 0.95 zuwa 0.97) amma ya gano mafi ƙanƙantar sauye-sauyen da za a iya yi, kamar ƙarin maki ɗaya da wuri ko ingantacciyar intanet a gida, da za su fitar da ɗalibi daga rukunin da ke cikin haɗari mafi girma. Makin shekarar farko, ci gaban maki da wuri, raunin zamantakewa da tattalin arziki da samun intanet a gida su ne mafi ƙarfin alamomi.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na 2 ya shafi AI da nazarin bayanai na hasashe don nasarar ɗalibai. Wannan yana ɗaga nazarin gargaɗi da wuri daga kawai nuna ɗaliban da ke cikin haɗari zuwa ba da takamaiman matakan tallafi masu araha, samfurin da Wits AHEAD za ta iya nuni da shi a aikin nasarar ɗalibai a wurare masu irin wannan kayan aiki.

entry.title: Largest meta-analysis yet finds AI-supported STEM teaching has a real, moderate effect on learning
entry.summary:
Wani nazarin bincike da ya haɗa bincike 35 na gwaji da na rabin gwaji ya gano cewa koyarwa da AI ke tallafawa tana samar da tasiri mai kyau na matsakaici kuma mai muhimmanci a ƙididdiga kan sakamakon koyon STEM (g = 0.67). Amfanin ya fi ƙarfi a tsakanin ɗaliban sakandare, kuma matakan tallafi da suka ɗauki wata ɗaya zuwa biyu sun nuna su ne mafi tasiri daga cikin tsawon lokacin da aka gwada.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na 3 ya shafi AI da nazarin bayanai a STEM da horar da malamai. Wannan yana cikin shaidun ƙididdiga mafiya bayyana zuwa yanzu cewa koyar da STEM da AI ke tallafawa yana aiki, kuma sakamakon kan mafi kyawun tsawon lokacin tallafi yana da amfani kai tsaye ga yadda Wits AHEAD ke tsara shirye-shiryenta na STEM da lokacinsu.

entry.title: Gates Foundation commits 1 billion US dollars over two years to equitable AI
entry.summary:
Gates Foundation ta yi alƙawarin aƙalla dala biliyan 1 ta Amurka a cikin shekaru biyu masu zuwa don gina da isar da AI mai adalci, inda aka ware miliyan 400 don ilimi, miliyan 400 don lafiya, miliyan 100 don noma da miliyan 100 don bayanan horar da AI a harsunan da ba a yi musu hidima sosai ba. Alƙawarin yana tare da rahoton Goalkeepers na goma na gidauniyar, mai taken Make This Matter: AI, Equity and the Choice We Can't Delay.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na 6 yana tambayar wanene ke tsara AI cikin alhaki kuma don su waye. Alƙawarin taimako na wannan girma, wanda ke nufin cike gibi ga yankuna mafiya talauci, zai tsara waɗanne kayan aikin AI a ilimi ne za su isa azuzuwan Kudancin Duniya da Wits AHEAD ke nazari.

Gates Foundation · Foundation press release accompanying its Goalkeepers report

entry.title: Systematic review of 105 studies finds Africa and Oceania missing from generative AI teacher research
entry.summary:
Wani bita da aka yi bisa jagorancin PRISMA na bincike 105 da masana suka tantance kan malamai da AI mai samar da abun ciki, waɗanda aka wallafa tun 2023 a manyan mujallun fasahar ilimi, ya gano cewa tushen shaidun ya taru a China, Turkiyya, Amurka da Spain, yayin da aka yi wa Afirka da Oceania ƙarancin wakilci sosai. Ilimin AI, ilimin koyarwa da amincewa da kai, ta mahangar samfurin TPACK, su ne mafi ƙarfin alamomin haɗa AI cikin aji yadda ya kamata, fiye da samun kayan aiki kawai.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na 3 ya shafi AI da nazarin bayanai a STEM da horar da malamai. Bita na wannan girma yana tabbatar da cewa binciken Wits AHEAD kan horar da malamai a Afirka yana cike gibin da aka rubuta maimakon maimaita fannin da ya cika.

entry.title: Stanford study finds a persistent 19% AI employment gap for young workers
entry.summary:
Digital Economy Lab na Stanford ya ba da rahoton cewa aikin yi tsakanin matasa masu shekaru 22 zuwa 25 a sana'o'in da AI ya fi shafa yanzu ya gaza da kashi 19% fiye da yadda zai kasance da ya tafi daidai da takwarorinsu da ba a shafa sosai ba, daga kashi 15% shekara guda da ta wuce. Gibin yana faruwa ne galibi ta hanyar raguwar ɗaukar ma'aikata maimakon rasa ayyuka, kuma ya fi yawa a ayyukan da suka dogara da ilimin da aka tsara kuma ake koyarwa a littafi kamar injiniyancin manhaja da hidimar abokan ciniki.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na 4 yana tambayar yadda AI ke sauya hanyar daga samun takardar shaida zuwa samun abin rayuwa. Wannan ita ce shaidar ƙididdiga mafi bayyana zuwa yanzu cewa ayyukan waɗanda suka kammala karatu na matakin farko da suka dogara da ilimi su ne ke fara taƙaita, abin da ke ƙara ƙarfafa buƙatar aikin ƙwarewar waɗanda suka kammala karatu da ya wuce takardun shaida.

Stanford Digital Economy Lab · University research institute report

entry.title: New Global South framework sets conditions for responsible generative AI in teaching
entry.summary:
Wani bita na kididdigar wallafe-wallafe da na tsari a International Journal of Emerging Technologies in Learning ya bibiyi rubuce-rubucen da ke ƙaruwa cikin sauri kan AI mai samar da abun ciki mai alhaki a koyarwa kuma ya ba da shawarar tsarin ra'ayi don Kudancin Duniya. Ya gano cewa Amurka, China da Ostiraliya ne ke jagorantar samar da bincike, tare da gano sanin ɗa'a, amana, tallafin cibiya, shirin ababen more rayuwa da ƙwarewar AI a matsayin sharuɗɗan da suka fi tasiri kan amfani.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na 6 ya shafi AI mai alhaki, ɗa'a, adalci da manufofi. Wannan tsarin yana ba Wits AHEAD ma'aunin da masana suka tantance don yin hukunci kan lokacin da amfani da AI mai samar da abun ciki a jami'o'in Kudu ke da alhaki da gaske ba wai kawai yana samuwa ba.

entry.title: PISA 2025 finds 15-year-olds who skip AI chatbots for schoolwork outscore those who rely on them, as global reading skills fall sharply
entry.summary:
Sakamakon PISA 2025 na OECD, da aka fitar a ranar 8 ga Satumba 2026, ya nuna makin karatu ya ragu da maki 28 a ƙasashen OECD da maki 16 a tsakanin sauran ƙasashe da tattalin arzikin da suka shiga tsakanin 2015 da 2025, ɗaya daga cikin mafi tsananin faɗuwa tun da aka fara wannan tantancewa. Rahoton ya gano cewa matasa masu shekaru 15 da ba sa amfani da chatbots na AI don aikin makaranta gaba ɗaya suna samun maki mafi girma fiye da masu amfani da su, kuma fiye da ɗalibi ɗaya cikin huɗu ya ce na'urorin dijital suna ɗauke hankalin abokan karatunsu a mafi yawan ko dukkan darussan kimiyya.

Dalilin muhimmancinsa ga AHEAD: Ginshiƙi na 5, nazarin bayanai da bayanai don tsarin ilimi da yanke shawara, ya samu a nan alama mai ƙarfi a matakin tsari: tantancewar duniya da ta haɗa dogaro mai yawa kan chatbots na AI da raunin sakamako, gargaɗin da Wits AHEAD ke aunawa kai tsaye da aikinta na ginshiƙi na 1 kan AI mai samar da abun ciki a koyarwa da tantancewa.
